lines.gurmukhi: ਰਾਮਕਲੀ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
lines.transliteration: raamakalee mahalaa 5 ||
lines.translation: Raamkalee, Fifth Mehl:

lines.gurmukhi: ਅੰਗੀਕਾਰੁ ਕੀਆ ਪ੍ਰਭਿ ਅਪਨੈ ਬੈਰੀ ਸਗਲੇ ਸਾਧੇ ॥
lines.transliteration: a(n)geekaar keeaa prabh apanai bairee sagale saadhe ||
lines.translation: God has made me His own, and vanquished all my enemies.

lines.gurmukhi: ਜਿਨਿ ਬੈਰੀ ਹੈ ਇਹੁ ਜਗੁ ਲੂਟਿਆ ਤੇ ਬੈਰੀ ਲੈ ਬਾਧੇ ॥੧॥
lines.transliteration: jin bairee hai ihu jag lootiaa te bairee lai baadhe ||1||
lines.translation: Those enemies who have plundered this world, have all been placed in bondage. ||1||

lines.gurmukhi: ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਪਰਮੇਸਰੁ ਮੇਰਾ ॥
lines.transliteration: satigur paramesar meraa ||
lines.translation: The True Guru is my Transcendent Lord.

lines.gurmukhi: ਅਨਿਕ ਰਾਜ ਭੋਗ ਰਸ ਮਾਣੀ ਨਾਉ ਜਪੀ ਭਰਵਾਸਾ ਤੇਰਾ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
lines.transliteration: anik raaj bhog ras maanee naau japee bharavaasaa teraa ||1|| rahaau ||
lines.translation: I enjoy countless pleasures of power and tasty delights, chanting Your Name, and placing my faith in You. ||1||Pause||

lines.gurmukhi: ਚੀਤਿ ਨ ਆਵਸਿ ਦੂਜੀ ਬਾਤਾ ਸਿਰ ਊਪਰਿ ਰਖਵਾਰਾ ॥
lines.transliteration: cheet na aavas doojee baataa sir oopar rakhavaaraa ||
lines.translation: I do not think of any other at all. The Lord is my protector, above my head.

lines.gurmukhi: ਬੇਪਰਵਾਹੁ ਰਹਤ ਹੈ ਸੁਆਮੀ ਇਕ ਨਾਮ ਕੈ ਆਧਾਰਾ ॥੨॥
lines.transliteration: beparavaahu rahat hai suaamee ik naam kai aadhaaraa ||2||
lines.translation: I am carefree and independent, when I have the Support of Your Name, O my Lord and Master. ||2||

lines.gurmukhi: ਪੂਰਨ ਹੋਇ ਮਿਲਿਓ ਸੁਖਦਾਈ ਊਨ ਨ ਕਾਈ ਬਾਤਾ ॥
lines.transliteration: pooran hoi milio sukhadaaee oon na kaaee baataa ||
lines.translation: I have become perfect, meeting with the Giver of peace, and now, I lack nothing at all.

lines.gurmukhi: ਤਤੁ ਸਾਰੁ ਪਰਮ ਪਦੁ ਪਾਇਆ ਛੋਡਿ ਨ ਕਤਹੂ ਜਾਤਾ ॥੩॥
lines.transliteration: tat saar param pad paaiaa chhod na katahoo jaataa ||3||
lines.translation: I have obtained the essence of excellence, the supreme status; I shall not forsake it to go anywhere else. ||3||

lines.gurmukhi: ਬਰਨਿ ਨ ਸਾਕਉ ਜੈਸਾ ਤੂ ਹੈ ਸਾਚੇ ਅਲਖ ਅਪਾਰਾ ॥
lines.transliteration: baran na saakau jaisaa too hai saache alakh apaaraa ||
lines.translation: I cannot describe how You are, O True Lord, unseen, infinite,

lines.gurmukhi: ਅਤੁਲ ਅਥਾਹ ਅਡੋਲ ਸੁਆਮੀ ਨਾਨਕ ਖਸਮੁ ਹਮਾਰਾ ॥੪॥੫॥
lines.transliteration: atul athaah adol suaamee naanak khasam hamaaraa ||4||5||
lines.translation: immeasurable, unfathomable and unmoving Lord. O Nanak, He is my Lord and Master. ||4||5||

lines.gurmukhi: ਰਾਮਕਲੀ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
lines.transliteration: raamakalee mahalaa 5 ||
lines.translation: Raamkalee, Fifth Mehl:

lines.gurmukhi: ਤੂ ਦਾਨਾ ਤੂ ਅਬਿਚਲੁ ਤੂਹੀ ਤੂ ਜਾਤਿ ਮੇਰੀ ਪਾਤੀ ॥
lines.transliteration: too daanaa too abichal toohee too jaat meree paatee ||
lines.translation: You are wise; You are eternal and unchanging. You are my social class and honor.

lines.gurmukhi: ਤੂ ਅਡੋਲੁ ਕਦੇ ਡੋਲਹਿ ਨਾਹੀ ਤਾ ਹਮ ਕੈਸੀ ਤਾਤੀ ॥੧॥
lines.transliteration: too adol kade dolahi naahee taa ham kaisee taatee ||1||
lines.translation: You are unmoving - You never move at all. How can I be worried? ||1||

lines.gurmukhi: ਏਕੈ ਏਕੈ ਏਕ ਤੂਹੀ ॥
lines.transliteration: ekai ekai ek toohee ||
lines.translation: You alone are the One and only Lord;

lines.gurmukhi: ਏਕੈ ਏਕੈ ਤੂ ਰਾਇਆ ॥
lines.transliteration: ekai ekai too raaiaa ||
lines.translation: You alone are the king.

lines.gurmukhi: ਤਉ ਕਿਰਪਾ ਤੇ ਸੁਖੁ ਪਾਇਆ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
lines.transliteration: tau kirapaa te sukh paaiaa ||1|| rahaau ||
lines.translation: By Your Grace, I have found peace. ||1||Pause||

lines.gurmukhi: ਤੂ ਸਾਗਰੁ ਹਮ ਹੰਸ ਤੁਮਾਰੇ ਤੁਮ ਮਹਿ ਮਾਣਕ ਲਾਲਾ ॥
lines.transliteration: too saagar ham ha(n)s tumaare tum mahi maanak laalaa ||
lines.translation: You are the ocean, and I am Your swan; the pearls and rubies are in You.

lines.gurmukhi: ਤੁਮ ਦੇਵਹੁ ਤਿਲੁ ਸੰਕ ਨ ਮਾਨਹੁ ਹਮ ਭੁੰਚਹ ਸਦਾ ਨਿਹਾਲਾ ॥੨॥
lines.transliteration: tum devahu til sa(n)k na maanahu ham bhu(n)chah sadaa nihaalaa ||2||
lines.translation: You give, and You do not hesitate for an instant; I receive, forever enraptured. ||2||

lines.gurmukhi: ਹਮ ਬਾਰਿਕ ਤੁਮ ਪਿਤਾ ਹਮਾਰੇ ਤੁਮ ਮੁਖਿ ਦੇਵਹੁ ਖੀਰਾ ॥
lines.transliteration: ham baarik tum pitaa hamaare tum mukh devahu kheeraa ||
lines.translation: I am Your child, and You are my father; You place the milk in my mouth.

lines.gurmukhi: ਹਮ ਖੇਲਹ ਸਭਿ ਲਾਡ ਲਡਾਵਹ ਤੁਮ ਸਦ ਗੁਣੀ ਗਹੀਰਾ ॥੩॥
lines.transliteration: ham khelah sabh laad ladaavah tum sad gunee gaheeraa ||3||
lines.translation: I play with You, and You caress me in every way. You are forever the ocean of excellence. ||3||

lines.gurmukhi: ਤੁਮ ਪੂਰਨ ਪੂਰਿ ਰਹੇ ਸੰਪੂਰਨ ਹਮ ਭੀ ਸੰਗਿ ਅਘਾਏ ॥
lines.transliteration: tum pooran poor rahe sa(n)pooran ham bhee sa(n)g aghaae ||
lines.translation: You are perfect, perfectly all-pervading; I am fulfilled with You as well.

lines.gurmukhi: ਮਿਲਤ ਮਿਲਤ ਮਿਲਤ ਮਿਲਿ ਰਹਿਆ ਨਾਨਕ ਕਹਣੁ ਨ ਜਾਏ ॥੪॥੬॥
lines.transliteration: milat milat milat mil rahiaa naanak kahan na jaae ||4||6||
lines.translation: I am merged, merged, merged and remain merged; O Nanak, I cannot describe it! ||4||6||

lines.gurmukhi: ਰਾਮਕਲੀ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
lines.transliteration: raamakalee mahalaa 5 ||
lines.translation: Raamkalee, Fifth Mehl:

lines.gurmukhi: ਕਰ ਕਰਿ ਤਾਲ ਪਖਾਵਜੁ ਨੈਨਹੁ ਮਾਥੈ ਵਜਹਿ ਰਬਾਬਾ ॥
lines.transliteration: kar kar taal pakhaavaj nainahu maathai vajahi rabaabaa ||
lines.translation: Make your hands the cymbals, your eyes the tambourines, and your forehead the guitar you play.

lines.gurmukhi: ਕਰਨਹੁ ਮਧੁ ਬਾਸੁਰੀ ਬਾਜੈ ਜਿਹਵਾ ਧੁਨਿ ਆਗਾਜਾ ॥
lines.transliteration: karanahu madh baasuree baajai jihavaa dhun aagaajaa ||
lines.translation: Let the sweet flute music resound in your ears, and with your tongue, vibrate this song.

lines.gurmukhi: ਨਿਰਤਿ ਕਰੇ ਕਰਿ ਮਨੂਆ ਨਾਚੈ ਆਣੇ ਘੂਘਰ ਸਾਜਾ ॥੧॥
lines.transliteration: nirat kare kar manooaa naachai aane ghooghar saajaa ||1||
lines.translation: Move your mind like the rhythmic hand-motions; do the dance, and shake your ankle bracelets. ||1||

lines.gurmukhi: ਰਾਮ ਕੋ ਨਿਰਤਿਕਾਰੀ ॥
lines.transliteration: raam ko niratikaaree ||
lines.translation: This is the rhythmic dance of the Lord.

lines.gurmukhi: ਪੇਖੈ ਪੇਖਨਹਾਰੁ ਦਇਆਲਾ ਜੇਤਾ ਸਾਜੁ ਸੀਗਾਰੀ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
lines.transliteration: pekhai pekhanahaar daiaalaa jetaa saaj seegaaree ||1|| rahaau ||
lines.translation: The Merciful Audience, the Lord, sees all your make-up and decorations. ||1||Pause||

lines.gurmukhi: ਆਖਾਰ ਮੰਡਲੀ ਧਰਣਿ ਸਬਾਈ ਊਪਰਿ ਗਗਨੁ ਚੰਦੋਆ ॥
lines.transliteration: aakhaar ma(n)dalee dharan sabaaee oopar gagan cha(n)doaa ||
lines.translation: The whole earth is the stage, with the canopy of the sky overhead.

lines.gurmukhi: ਪਵਨੁ ਵਿਚੋਲਾ ਕਰਤ ਇਕੇਲਾ ਜਲ ਤੇ ਓਪਤਿ ਹੋਆ ॥
lines.transliteration: pavan vicholaa karat ikelaa jal te opat hoaa ||
lines.translation: The wind is the director; people are born of water.

lines.gurmukhi: ਪੰਚ ਤਤੁ ਕਰਿ ਪੁਤਰਾ ਕੀਨਾ ਕਿਰਤ ਮਿਲਾਵਾ ਹੋਆ ॥੨॥
lines.transliteration: pa(n)ch tat kar putaraa keenaa kirat milaavaa hoaa ||2||
lines.translation: From the five elements, the puppet was created with its actions. ||2||

lines.gurmukhi: ਚੰਦੁ ਸੂਰਜੁ ਦੁਇ ਜਰੇ ਚਰਾਗਾ ਚਹੁ ਕੁੰਟ ਭੀਤਰਿ ਰਾਖੇ ॥
lines.transliteration: cha(n)d sooraj dui jare charaagaa chahu ku(n)t bheetar raakhe ||
lines.translation: The sun and the moon are the two lamps which shine, with the four corners of the world placed between them.

lines.gurmukhi: ਦਸ ਪਾਤਉ ਪੰਚ ਸੰਗੀਤਾ ਏਕੈ ਭੀਤਰਿ ਸਾਥੇ ॥
lines.transliteration: das paatau pa(n)ch sa(n)geetaa ekai bheetar saathe ||
lines.translation: The ten senses are the dancing girls, and the five passions are the chorus; they sit together within the one body.

lines.gurmukhi: ਭਿੰਨ ਭਿੰਨ ਹੋਇ ਭਾਵ ਦਿਖਾਵਹਿ ਸਭਹੁ ਨਿਰਾਰੀ ਭਾਖੇ ॥੩॥
lines.transliteration: bhi(n)n bhi(n)n hoi bhaav dikhaavahi sabhahu niraaree bhaakhe ||3||
lines.translation: They all put on their own shows, and speak in different languages. ||3||

lines.gurmukhi: ਘਰਿ ਘਰਿ ਨਿਰਤਿ ਹੋਵੈ ਦਿਨੁ ਰਾਤੀ ਘਟਿ ਘਟਿ ਵਾਜੈ ਤੂਰਾ ॥
lines.transliteration: ghar ghar nirat hovai din raatee ghat ghat vaajai tooraa ||
lines.translation: In each and every home there is dancing, day and night; in each and every home, the bugles blow.

lines.gurmukhi: ਏਕਿ ਨਚਾਵਹਿ ਏਕਿ ਭਵਾਵਹਿ ਇਕਿ ਆਇ ਜਾਇ ਹੋਇ ਧੂਰਾ ॥
lines.transliteration: ek nachaavahi ek bhavaavahi ik aai jaai hoi dhooraa ||
lines.translation: Some are made to dance, and some are whirled around; some come and some go, and some are reduced to dust.

lines.gurmukhi: ਕਹੁ ਨਾਨਕ ਸੋ ਬਹੁਰਿ ਨ ਨਾਚੈ ਜਿਸੁ ਗੁਰੁ ਭੇਟੈ ਪੂਰਾ ॥੪॥੭॥
lines.transliteration: kahu naanak so bahur na naachai jis gur bhetai pooraa ||4||7||
lines.translation: Says Nanak, one who meets with the True Guru, does not have to dance the dance of reincarnation again. ||4||7||
